$comment: POST /api/chat.update, read from Slack's method reference. It replaces a message the app posted, addressed by its channel and ts. This is what a host calls after a button click; the click's response_url is deliberately NOT used, because a URL taken from a delivery would make the package contact an address the request chose.
title: Slack message update
description: Replace the text and blocks of a Slack message the app posted.
$idempotencyComment: Replacing a message with the same content leaves it as it was, so a retried update is harmless.

resultCheck.$comment: Slack returns HTTP 200 for application failures. message_not_found and cant_update_message are Slack's own reasons, and they are kept.

config.label: Channel
config.description: The conversation ID holding the message, as returned when it was posted or carried in a click.

config.label: Message ts
config.description: The message's ts, its stable identifier within the channel.

config.label: Message
config.description: The replacement top-level text, kept as the accessible fallback for the blocks.

config.label: Blocks
config.description: Optional replacement Block Kit layout: a JSON array of blocks.

outputShape.description: True after resultCheck has established Slack accepted the update.
The updated message's ts, unchanged by the update.
The message text as Slack stored it.
